Submitted answer: kàíɛ̌ jǎŋɛ̌ lɔ̀ɔ̀. Verified answer: kàí jǎŋɛ̌ lɔ̀ɔ̀-mùsú.

The submitted answer has two errors:

1. **Missing female element.** "Brother" is the compound lɔ̀ɔ̀-kàì, so "sister" should be lɔ̀ɔ̀-mùsú. Bare lɔ̀ɔ̀ appears elsewhere as the adjective "small" (kɔ̀ánjà lɔ̀ɔ̀ɛ̌), so the submitted lɔ̀ɔ̀ does not mean "sister".
2. **Extra suffix on the possessor noun.** In adjective-modified possessors, the suffix -ɛ̌ goes on the adjective only (mùsú jǎŋɛ̌, nyìmìì kúndúɛ̌). The noun stays bare, giving kàí jǎŋɛ̌, not kàíɛ̌ jǎŋɛ̌.

The submitted form matches neither the pattern nor the target translation.
